hypothesis: Restricting updates of a 200k-trained base to 50k states contributes to the observed same-source regression; restoring broader fitting support may improve transfer at unchanged update work.
changed_factor: Candidate-update fitting support only, 50k to180k. Reuse completed 50k averaged controls, do not rerun.
selection: Old verified 50k positions first, then remaining positions in original200k order excluding the fixed U20k. Assert exact prefix states/labels/base, unique positions and no U IDs. Dataset namespaces retained.
fixed: Original continued bases, all preprocessing, 4x800 GELU, FP32 weights/FP64 decoding and loss, physical log1p, fresh Adam foreach=false, cosine1e-7 to1e-8,3000updates,10000batch,1000microbatch, final checkpoint and every evaluator gate
work_policy: 30M row presentations and3000optimizer updates per fit, matching50k averaged controls. More diversity and fewer presentations per unique row; not equal epochs or wall time.
exposure: Existing permitted training labels only; no reference generation. U20k remains excluded from candidate updates although the base/preprocessing saw it historically. D1023 remains repeated development; confirmation closed.
evaluation: T180k labelled separately from old T50k; identical full U20k/D1023 across arms and controls; protected gates against fixed anchor/incumbent, independent recount and fresh base replay

outcomes.transfer_restored_and_gates_pass: Record development-qualified status under authorized process; continue robustness without opening confirmation
outcomes.transfer_better_but_no_qualification: Retain tradeoff status, quantify remaining guards; no automatic size ladder
outcomes.no_useful_gain: Close low-step base-continuation family provisionally after this support control; do not sweep batch or learning rate
